correctness.rationale: The all-event depth is exactly maximum component diameter by induction on neighbourhood radius. Maximum n-1 is possible only for a spanning induced geodesic, hence the graph is a path. Its edge-agent labels are nonempty and consecutive labels are disjoint precisely because individual agent relations are equivalences; matching-based reconstruction proves the converse and uniqueness. An exact path-edge transfer counts all labelled relation tuples. The standalone checker enumerated all relation tuples for two agents through six states and for three through five; the transfer counts matched every tested case, but the general theorem rests on the proof.

The inspected motivating 2026 work proves modal and proof-theoretic results, not a sharp all-size finite unfolding extremal census. Actual source/alias and structural searches did not locate a dominating formula; older combinatorial walk enumerations remain a genuine potential overlap.

value.rationale: The precise finite stage where nested everybody-knows reaches the common-knowledge fixed point is a natural operational invariant. The sharp bound, complete equality classification and exact all-agent enumeration determine both worst cases and their labelled prevalence, not an arbitrary small-case invariant. The transfer recurrence resolves the nontrivial possibility of several agents sharing each equivalence edge while forbidding adjacent repetitions. Results are restricted to maximal depth; that restriction is a mathematically motivated extremal boundary.
